preregistration_note: Figure and table identities were frozen while the first formal 500 ps trajectory and k-point convergence calculation were still incomplete. Layout may be improved without changing estimands, source rows, acceptance gates, or the mandatory inclusion of negative and unresolved outcomes.
claim_boundary: Every plot and table must be regenerated from hash-verified reports. Filled/open or pass/fail encodings must retain rejected points. Room-temperature predictions must be visually marked as extrapolations. Experimental compatibility is descriptive, and mechanism associations are not causal claims.
